summary: Add a concise, safe documentation comment to README.md without changing functional code or project behavior.
scope: Inspect README.md to identify an appropriate documentation location.
Add one non-sensitive, accurate documentation comment.
Preserve existing README structure and content.
out_of_scope: Modifying source code, configuration, dependencies, or other documentation files.
Adding secrets, credentials, personal data, or unverifiable claims.

acceptance_criteria.description: README.md contains the requested safe documentation comment in an appropriate location.
No files other than README.md are changed.
The added comment contains no sensitive information and does not alter application behavior.

required_validations: Review the README diff to confirm the comment is accurate, non-sensitive, and limited to README.md.
